raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers migrated to the new CRM since 2026-01-15 carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. silver_customers passes these codes through unchanged, which splits gold_region_daily by code. The change notes document the migration, and raw_region_map provides a one-to-one code-to-name mapping, so the correct names can be recovered.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT region_code, region_name FROM raw_region_map) m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code"}}
